title: Treasure chest with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Treasure chest with smiling face -->
  <!-- Chest body -->
  <rect x="18" y="48" width="64" height="38" rx="4" fill="#c07830" stroke="#e0a050" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Chest lid -->
  <rect x="18" y="34" width="64" height="18" rx="8" fill="#b06828" stroke="#e0a050" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Lid curve highlight -->
  <rect x="22" y="36" width="56" height="10" rx="5" fill="#d08838"/>
  <!-- Metal bands -->
  <rect x="30" y="34" width="4" height="52" fill="#e0a050" rx="1"/>
  <rect x="66" y="34" width="4" height="52" fill="#e0a050" rx="1"/>
  <!-- Lock -->
  <rect x="42" y="52" width="16" height="14" rx="3" fill="#f0c060" stroke="#ffe08a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="3" fill="#ffe08a"/>
  <!-- Wood grain lines -->
  <line x1="22" y1="62" x2="62" y2="62" stroke="#a85a20" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="38" y1="74" x2="78" y2="74" stroke="#a85a20" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Smiling eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="44" rx="4" ry="4.5" fill="#ffe08a"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="44" rx="4" ry="4.5" fill="#ffe08a"/>
  <!-- Eye sparkle -->
  <circle cx="37.5" cy="42.5" r="1.5" fill="#fff8e0"/>
  <circle cx="65.5" cy="42.5" r="1.5" fill="#fff8e0"/>
  <!-- Happy smile -->
  <path d="M38 53 Q50 64 62 53" stroke="#ffe08a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="50" r="3" fill="#e88858" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="50" r="3" fill="#e88858" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- Gold coins peeking out -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="33" r="4" fill="#ffd700"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="33" r="2.5" fill="#ffe850"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="31" r="4.5" fill="#ffd700"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="31" r="3" fill="#ffe850"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="33" r="3.5" fill="#ffd700"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="33" r="2" fill="#ffe850"/>
</svg>
